'''Gozarkhani''' or '''Alamuti''', is a moribund [[Northwestern Iranian languages|Northwestern Iranian language]] and is a part of the Tatic group of Iranian vernaculars.<ref>{{Glottolog|goza1238|Alamuti}}</ref> It is a [[Tatoid dialects|Tatoid]] dialect.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Geomatics and Cartographic Research Centre |first=Carleton University |title=Atlas of the Languages of Iran |url=https://www.iranatlas.net/index.html?module=module.classification |access-date=2026-03-05 |website=www.iranatlas.net |language=English}}</ref>
